title: Anagram Clusters
commonMistakes: Using a Set of letters as the key, which loses how many times each letter occurs
Sorting only the outer list but not the words inside each group
Dropping duplicate words instead of keeping every input occurrence
Assuming every word has at least one character
followUps: How can a 26-slot letter-count key avoid sorting each word?
What changes if words may contain uppercase letters or digits?
How would you process a stream of words that does not fit in memory?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
